text:
rachel: Morning all 12 thinking about a lean 'SI Lab Passport' to speed up SI onboarding. Short, portable labs they can complete against partner sandboxes and earn a badge.
pavel: Sounds useful. How many labs & time commitment? Where do they run?
rachel: 3 labs: infra prep (90m), app deploy (90m), failover/DR scenario (90m). Partners host ephemeral sandboxes. Pilot cohort = 10 SIs.
aj: We should keep artifacts small: ask for a screenshot + one `curl` response as a minimal proof of work. Low friction to grade.
devon: I can lock down seats with VectorGrid and BroadPeak. VectorGrid offers ephemeral clusters via `vg-cluster create --ttl 2h`. I can reserve 8 seats/week in May.
partners-bot: Draft created: https://docs.redwood.com/si/lab-passport/draft 023-05-01 10:00 AM PT 0 comments welcome.
pavel: Assessment flow idea: automated scoring of lab outputs (artifact presence + simple tests) + 10-min live Q&A for edge cases. Store submissions under `partners/<si-id>/lab-passport` in the portal.
rachel: Badge levels: "Passport" (complete labs), "Passport+Marketplace" (adds staging deploy verification for co-marketing). Marketplace listing only for Passport+ partners.
aj: Marketplace verification checklist = 1 staging deploy + 2 smoke tests passing. We add a UI checkbox in partner portal: `staging_deploy_verified`.
devon: Voucher token format proposal: `RWD-PASS-XXXX` (single-use, expires 30 days). I'll publish tokens to the partner portal once legal approves.
pavel: Legal note: must use scrubbed or synthetic data for failover/DR labs. I'll draft wording for the T&Cs and SSO onboarding requirements.
rachel: Owners: devon = lab ops & vouchers, aj = grading rubric + staging checklist, pavel = legal & SSO, rachel = comms + pilot invites.
aj: I'll prototype a simple grading sheet (pass/fail checkpoints + points) and paste it in the doc.
devon: Suggest we record 5-8 min micro-lessons per lab for asynchronous learners and keep live sessions focused on hands-on. Also: a short runbook for infra quota requests.
pavel: Also flag: any partner-provided infra must expose an egress filter and audit logs for compliance 12 I'll include that in the runbook.
rachel: Timeline: outline by Tue EOD, full draft by Fri, pilot cohort runs mid-June. 30-min planning sync Tue 11am — ping if you want in. :calendar:
aj: +1 I'll join and bring a sample rubric. :white_check_mark:
devon: Cool, I'll start outreach to VectorGrid ops and confirm seat counts.
partners-bot: Reminder set: review draft by Friday 5pm PT.
rachel: Thanks everyone 12 excited to see this move fast.
